weather.summary: Chance Showers And Thunderstorms then Mostly Cloudy
weather.blurb: Gusts strong enough to drop tree limbs until 7 p.m. Tie down the patio umbrella.

air.blurb: Clear air. A great day to be outside.

lake.blurb: The lake is close to full — good for boats and for the summer water supply. Down a touch from last week.

pollen.note: Tree 4 · Grass 3 · Weed 4 · Elm, Ragweed, Grasses
pollen.blurb: Elm and ragweed and grasses are heavy today. Windows closed, meds early.

grid.blurb: Demand peaks near 57,500 megawatts; ERCOT has 102,200 ready and room to spare.

sun.blurb: The sun is up for 11 hours and 25 minutes today, and down by 6:58 p.m.
